question: Each of the digits in the number 54761829 is arranged in descending order from left to right. What will the product of the digits that are third from the left and second from the right in the new number thus formed be?
solution:
**Given:** Each of the digits in the number 54761829 is arranged in descending order from left to right.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca5df9bc2b8f9c1211e5b4f7e7479d8bc0c6c2f97e550e6ea1fa1c1254aec5d5.png] 

Digit third from left → 7

Digit second from right → 2

Product = 7 × 2 = 14

Thus, 14 will be the product of the digits that are third from the left and second from the right in the new number thus formed.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
